en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a city nestled in a valley with hills in the background. In the foreground stands a large complex of multi‑storey institutional buildings, likely a hospital, with many windows and flat roofs. Behind it stretches the city with church towers and other historic buildings, while wooded hills rise further back. The printed caption at the top reads in German about Graz and a new hospital with a view of the city. There are faint postal cancellation marks near the top.
